questions.q: 想再點一碗拉麵，哪句正確？
opts: Could I have more one bowl?
questions.exp: another 在此接單數可數名詞 bowl。
昨天已結束的事件用過去簡單式。

questions.q: 請對方慢一點重說，哪句自然？
opts: Could you say that again, more slowly?
Could you say again that slow?
Could you to say that again?
questions.exp: could 後接原形動詞 say，more slowly 修飾說話方式。

questions.q: 想問能不能走路到達，哪句適合？
questions.exp: within walking distance 表示在步行可及的距離內。

questions.q: 哪句提供了喜歡食物的理由？
opts: I liked it because the broth was rich.

questions.q: 想請店員結帳，哪句適合？
opts: Could we have the bill, please?
questions.exp: have the bill 是請店員提供帳單的自然說法。
